reason: Last year at home it was way too cramped, and for the whole preschool group I need a proper exclusive room. 4.9 from 173 reviews and a cafe in Banino, close by, make it an easy choice once I ask on 'Mamy z Banina' and people confirm it.
objection: The 'up to 8 kids' base is a trap for a preschool group: 20+ kids makes MINI about 1030 zł, FUN with a second animator closer to 1600 zł, and on top of that I can't bring my own cake for the adults and have to pay 170-190 zł for theirs.
